answer_1.quote: End-to-end dialogue system directly reads and outputs the utterances in natural language form.

answer_2.quote: Metric. We follow the standard evaluation metric using the official code, which computes three metrics on the MultiWOZ test set: BLEU (average BLEU scores between generated and ground truth response), Info (percentage of dialogs where the system presents an appropriate entity) and Succ (percentage of dialogs where the task goals are achieved).
